stories.sourceText: Library scoped statements keep Bulletin and Notice tied to their original actors, versions, periods and access scopes. If the permit is granted, Bulletin reports Morning by Library in version V1 during April for weekday access as disputed: doors might open at 2.50 hours. Notice reports Evening by Library in version V2 during May for weekend access as unresolved: doors remain closed until 3.00 hours. Morning and Evening differ in scope and remain disputed. Morning and Evening remain disputed after checking their scopes.

stories.sourceText: Clinic framing comparison keeps Whole and Reviewed tied to the identical patient records, without replacing the reported underlying quantities. Clinic total patients is 100.00 count during June among V1 patient records with denominator 200. Clinic reviewed patients is 60.00 count during June among V1 patient records with denominator 200. Whole and Reviewed retain the same total patients and reviewed patients and change the reference from total patients to reviewed patients. Whole and Reviewed keep total patients and reviewed patients unchanged after the reference switch.
